description: Ireland is contributing EUR 200,000 (approximately CHF 185,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) in 2026 to strengthen sanitary and phytosanitary capacity in developing and least-developed countries. The contribution will support STDF activities that help countries meet international food safety and animal and plant health standards, as well as facilitate safe and inclusive trade.

title: South Africa notifies launch of safeguard investigation into certain non-wired float glass products
description: On 11 November 2026, South Africa notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 3 November 2026 of a safeguard investigation into imports of certain non-wired float glass products.

title: Ethiopia's accession maintains momentum as WTO members review progress
description: At its eighth meeting on 9 and 10 November, the Working Party on Ethiopia's Accession to the WTO took stock of the latest progress in bilateral market access negotiations and reforms of Ethiopia's foreign trade regime. Leading a high-level delegation, Ethiopia's Minister of Trade and Regional Integration and Chief Trade Negotiator, Yasmin Wohabrebbi Saeed, reaffirmed the priority the government continues to attach to achieving WTO accession as soon as possible. title: Germany contributes EUR 500,000 to strengthen developing economies' trade capacity
description: Germany is contributing EUR 500,000 (approximately CHF 460,000) to the WTO's Global Trust Fund (GTF) to help developing economies and least developed countries (LDCs) enhance their participation in the multilateral trading system. Carmen Heidecke, Ambassador of Germany to the WTO, signed the Memorandum of Understanding on behalf of the German Federal Government at the WTO headquarters in Geneva on 9 November 2026.

title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
description: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (6 November 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.

title: Director-General: Leverage trade and partnerships to build a resilient ocean economy
description: The multilateral trading system provides important tools for the development of a healthy and prosperous ocean economy, Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said in her keynote speech at an event on Trade, Biodiversity and the Ocean Economy: Pathways to Resilience at the WTO on 5 November. Highlighting the importance of strengthening support for coastal and island economies, she said: Trade is part of the answer. The oceans are an asset of the global commons that can best be managed through mult

title: Members review progress in resolving SPS trade concerns at WTO
description: The WTO's Committee on Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) Measures met on 4-6 November, receiving an update on the resolution of past SPS-related trade concerns raised by members, reviewing a list of new and previously raised trade concerns, and advancing work on transparency, mentoring and technical cooperation issues.

title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.

title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain new hybrid vehicles
description: On 30 October 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (30 October 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain new hybrid vehicles.

title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties in 2026 already far exceed previous years’ tolls
description: This year has seen dramatically higher civilian casualties in Ukraine than any other year since the full-scale invasion of the eastern European country by Russia in February 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine (HRMMU) said on Tuesday.

title: World News in Brief: Ebola cases double in DR Congo, chemical exposure starts before birth, Türk concern over EU-Rwanda transfer plan
description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has more than doubled in three months, with more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths now reported in 67 health zones across eight provinces, the head of the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday.

title: COP31: The push to protect warming oceans reaches the negotiating table
description: From identifying marine life with a cup of seawater to drawing on Indigenous knowledge to prevent wildfires, scientists and communities showcased both cutting-edge and time-tested ways to protect nature at COP31 on Tuesday. Yet turning innovation into action remains a challenge, with funding gaps persisting and ministers struggling to bridge divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance as negotiations enter their final days.

title: Haiti: ‘Atrocious abuses’ continue as UN warns anti-gang operations must priortise civilian protection
description: The UN human rights office, OHCHR has urged greater protection for civilians in Haiti amid ongoing “atrocious abuses” committed by gangs and intensified security operations.

title: ‘Hunger should not be a concern’: WFP steps in for families in Kenya who fled Ethiopia violence
description: The World Food Programme (WFP) is assisting thousands of families who fled recent violence in Ethiopia for the Moyale area in neighbouring Kenya, the UN agency reported on Tuesday.

title: Winter rains deepen Gaza crisis amid restricted access and aid cuts
description: Gaza is facing a deepening shelter, sanitation and food security crisis as winter rains flood makeshift shelters, destroy scarce food supplies and leave displaced families struggling to stay warm and fed.

title: ‘Peace begins in our hearts’: Children close Muscat forum with a message to the world
description: Children from across the world sent a message of peace from the Omani capital Muscat on Monday, calling for an end to hatred, respect for diversity and the protection of human rights.

title: ‘An unfulfilled plan helps no one’: Superbug plans have doubled, but few countries are delivering
description: More countries are drawing up plans to tackle antimicrobial resistance (AMR), but major gaps in testing and treatment mean billions of people continue to be at risk, according to new data released by the World Health Organization (WHO) on Monday.

title: Lebanon leading the way in mental health support
description: Mental health support must be a core part of the humanitarian response, said the UN Deputy Secretary-General during a visit to Lebanon over the weekend, where efforts to address the psychological toll of years of conflict and instability offer valuable lessons for other crisis-affected countries.

title: AI gets climate science right – until users push back
description: The best AI models answer most climate science questions correctly, but they often abandon established facts as soon as a user disagrees, according to a new report co-authored by the UN.

title: Syria: Progress ‘real’ but fragile, as remnants of war wreck young lives
description: Syria is showing “undeniable signs of progress” nearly two years after the fall of the Assad regime, but explosive ordnance, the approaching winter and severe funding shortfalls threaten those fragile gains, senior UN officials told the Security Council on Monday.

title: COP31 enters decisive week as climate talks face political test and AI initiatives gather pace
description: New international initiatives on artificial intelligence and green industrialization showcased technology’s growing role in climate action, even as negotiators remained deadlocked on finance, fossil fuels and adaptation ahead of the final stretch of the UN talks.

title: Funding cuts raise risks of trafficking and exploitation for refugee children
description: Sharp reductions in humanitarian funding are putting refugees, particularly children, at increased risk of being trafficked, exploited or abused, while the systems that protect them are weakening.

title: Guterres calls for a legally binding instrument for ‘killer robots'
description: Talks began in Geneva on Monday to push for controls on lethal autonomous weapons systems that are often referred to as “killer robots”.

title: At his final ASEAN Summit, Guterres upholds cooperation and action on Myanmar
description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres underscored the need for stronger collaboration with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and an end to the crisis in Myanmar, in remarks to regional leaders meeting in the Philippine capital Manila on Monday.

title: First Person: Managing risk on Ukraine’s frontline
description: Humanitarian workers providing support to communities on the frontline of the war between Ukraine and Russia must balance remaining close to those in need with the heightened risks of operating in a conflict zone, according to the top UN official in Ukraine.

title: Empowering faith and Indigenous leaders to combat hate
description: Religious, traditional and Indigenous leaders need to be empowered to act as full partners in preventing conflict, not just praised for their role, speakers said Sunday at the opening of the Muscat Plan of Action Forum in Oman.

title: Nadia Murad: ‘Day by day, I took my story back’
description: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Nadia Murad has spent years telling the world about the atrocities committed against her and the Yazidi community by militants from the terrorist group, ISIL.

title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
description: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.

title: ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years
description: In a quiet hospital corridor in Kyiv, staff and volunteers push carts carrying steaming pots of chicken soup, bread and buckwheat porridge to patients recently evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky, in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region.

title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
description: Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge. Iran has all but closed the Strait of Hormuz, which carried a fifth of the world’s oil before the conflict. Attacks on shipping are rising, and efforts to stop a return to full-scale fighting have yet to produce a deal. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the threat to regional and maritime security. Follow live below – and for full meetings coverage year

title: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay
description: From emotional appeals for climate justice to high-stakes negotiations over billions of dollars, finance dominated discussions at COP31 on Friday. UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned that even tripling adaptation funding for vulnerable countries would meet less than a third of their needs, as pressure mounted on wealthy nations and major polluters to pay their fair share.

title: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza
description: Winter supplies must enter the Gaza Strip where “lives are at stake”, the UN and partners said in an urgent appeal on Friday, in the wake of deadly rainfall this past weekend.

title: COP31: New initiative targets AI and reliable climate change information
description: New guidance has been issued to ensure that people everywhere can obtain credible climate change information from artificial intelligence (AI) and understand how the technology impacts the environment.

title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response
description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread amid repeated and ongoing deadly attacks on civilians and frontline health workers by armed groups that are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, UN responders said on Friday.

title: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
description: An Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital on Wednesday night killed six people, injured 27 others and caused extensive damage.

title: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis
description: The World Food Programme’s (WFP) new Executive Director has warned that funding cuts are worsening Sudan’s hunger crisis following his first field mission to the country, where he met families displaced by conflict and struggling to feed their children.

title: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes
description: UN agencies on Thursday launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, that aims to secure access to more than $3 billion in risk financing to protect 75 million people and their livelihoods from climate shocks and natural hazards by 2030.

title: COP31: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action
description: From flooded homes to melting Himalayan glaciers, the human cost of climate change took centre stage at COP31 on Thursday, as world leaders turned their attention to protecting cities and vulnerable communities, while activists challenged governments to do more.

title: Kenya begins countdown towards end of Ebola after last patient discharged
description: Kenya began a 42-day countdown to the end of its Ebola outbreak on Thursday, a day after the last patient being treated for the disease went home and 11 people were released from quarantine.
